title: Join-rules router returns HTTP 500 join_rules_unavailable when the store reports `locked` (another writer holds the per-tenant lock, transient and retryable), identical to `lock-failed` / permission failures; a client cannot tell 'retry in a moment' from 'broken'. router.ts:14 comment also still says the store read-modify-write is unlocked.
evidence: Reproduction (on 1414d79): router with a store double whose recordOptOut/save/load throws JoinRulesStoreError code `locked`; POST /calendar/join-rules/opt-outs (and PUT, approvals) -> 500 {"error":"join_rules_unavailable"}, no Retry-After. Same body as code `lock-failed`.
fix_direction: Total code->status table; locked -> 503 join_rules_busy + Retry-After; lock-failed stays 500; no store message leaks.
reproductions: PUT with locked -> expect 503 join_rules_busy + Retry-After
lock-failed on all three -> still 500 join_rules_unavailable
